title: IT Validation & Automation Engineer
description: Company Description Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. Job Description Role: Validation Automation Engineer Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Work mode: Hybrid, Weekly 3 Days WFO Experience: 5–8+ years Reporting line: Manager Role Overview Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing (BPT) operates a global network of bio/pharmaceutical GMP product testing laboratories. BPT is supported by global engineering teams developing and maintaining business-critical laboratory applications, including eLIMS-BPT, Eurofins ELN, eQMS and related platforms. As a Validation Automation Engineer within the BPT delivery and validation function, the successful candidate will ensure continuity, accuracy and compliance of release-validation activities while progressively automating repetitive work. The role combines hands-on IT validation, controlled documentation, requirements traceability and software automation. Quality, compliance and human review remain central as existing processes are converted into reliable and reusable solutions. Required Experience and Skills : 5 to 8 years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, IT validation, test automation or quality/compliance roles supporting regulated applications. Hands-on experience performing validation activities for major and minor releases, patches, emergency changes and production data updates. Experience reviewing release scope, user requirements, Product Backlog Items (PBIs), defects and supporting test evidence for completeness and consistency. Ability to prepare, maintain and reconcile validation checklists, Requests for Change (RfCs), Module Functional Definitions (MFDs), release item lists and requirements traceability records. Good understanding of controlled documentation, document lifecycle, revision history, effectivity dates, review and approval workflows, and audit-ready record keeping. Ability to identify missing evidence, documentation gaps, traceability discrepancies and incorrectly classified functional, non-functional or technical work items. Experience coordinating with functional analysts, test engineers, developers, application owners and quality stakeholders to resolve validation gaps without compromising release timelines. Experience supporting recurring compliance activities such as Production Operational Data Updates (PODUs), SOP updates and controlled document submissions. Ability to understand manual processes, identify automation opportunities and translate them into maintainable scripts, utilities or workflows. Experience developing automation with suitable error handling, logging, traceability, version control and human review checkpoints. Strong analytical, documentation and problem-solving skills, with careful attention to data accuracy and cross-document consistency. Excellent understanding of SDLC, STLC, change control and Agile/Scrum delivery practices. Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders and managing time-sensitive release deliverables. Specific Technical Skills : Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps for PBIs, bugs, user requirements, work item history, release scope, queries and end-to-end traceability. Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, C#, JavaScript or PowerShell for workflow and data automation. Experience automating validation checklist preparation, evidence collection, work-item history verification, requirements traceability and cross-document reconciliation. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for validation checklists, reconciliation, data analysis and controlled reporting. Experience with Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Office for controlled documentation, templates, references and supporting records. Working knowledge of quality-management/change-control systems for RfC workflows. Working knowledge of eJIRA or comparable tools for document-control requests and tracking. Experience with Git-based version control and CI/CD practices for managing, testing and deploying automation solutions. Ability to validate automated outputs and maintain automation specifications, test results and change history before using outputs in controlled documentation. Good understanding of APIs, JSON, XML, SQL and data extraction techniques is advantageous for integrating validation and reporting workflows. Desirable Experience: Experience in a GxP-regulated, pharmaceutical, laboratory or life-sciences environment. Knowledge of Computer System Validation (CSV), data integrity principles and risk-based validation approaches. Experience supporting LIMS, ELN, eQMS or other regulated laboratory applications. Experience automating Azure DevOps administration or reporting activities, including metrics, dashboards, sprint and work-item management. Exposure to robotic process automation, low-code workflow tools or AI-assisted document and evidence checks within approved quality controls. Understanding of audit preparation, inspection readiness and quality review expectations. Additional Information Personal Skills: Customer-service oriented with a problem-solving attitude; Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential; Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change; Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing); Structured and clear writing skills; Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning; Demonstrated positive attitude, self-motivated, team player. PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA : Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.
